hints: All the probabilities must add up to $1$.

questions.prompt:
$400$ students were asked which sport they liked best.

$220$ of the $400$ students were boys.
$90$ of the boys said they liked football best.
$50$ of the girls said they liked tennis best.

$140$ of the students said they liked football best.
$130$ of the students said they liked swimming best.

(a) Complete the two-way table below. (3)

One of these $400$ people is chosen at random.

(b) Find the probability that this person is a girl who said she liked swimming best. (2)
hints: Start with the totals: the two rows must add to the grand total, and so must the three columns.
Fill in any cell where you know all but one value in its row or column.
For (b), read the single cell from the table and put it over the grand total.
questions.solution:
(a) Girls $= 400 - 220 = 180$. Tennis total $= 400 - 140 - 130 = 130$. [B1]
Girls football $= 140 - 90 = 50$. Boys tennis $= 130 - 50 = 80$. [B1]
Girls swimming $= 180 - 50 - 50 = 80$. Boys swimming $= 130 - 80 = 50$. [B1]

(b) $\dfrac{80}{400} = \dfrac{1}{5}$ (any equivalent fraction, decimal or percentage) [M1 A1]
